summary: Fixed TV Guide schedule synchronization bug. The /api/tv-guide endpoint was missing the 'random_play' field, causing TV Guide to show videos in original order instead of shuffled order. Added random_play to the API response. Now Live TV and TV Guide schedules match correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: Schedule items appear very densely packed with overlapping text due to many short-duration videos
ui_bugs.details: With 292 schedule items displayed across 24 hours, some text overlaps and is hard to read

issues: Some YouTube videos show 'Video unavailable' error - this is content issue, not code issue

passed_tests: TV Guide page loads successfully with 24-hour schedule
Schedule starts from midnight (00:00) and covers 24 hours
'Now' button scrolls to current time correctly
'Now Playing' indicator correctly highlights current video
TV Guide schedule matches Live TV schedule (same video plays at same time)
Random play channels show shuffled order consistently on both pages
Shuffle icon (purple) displays next to random_play channels
Videos positioned at correct times based on actual video durations
Schedule progresses: Video 30 → Video 32 → Video 33 → Video 4 → Video 27 → Video 1

bug_fixed.issue: TV Guide schedule did not match Live TV schedule
bug_fixed.root_cause: /api/tv-guide endpoint was missing 'random_play' field in response
bug_fixed.fix_applied: Added 'random_play': channel.get('random_play', False) to the TV Guide API response in server.py
bug_fixed.result: TV Guide now uses shuffled video order for random_play channels, matching Live TV

critical_code_review_comments: The fix was straightforward - the API was simply missing a field
Both TVGuide.jsx and LiveTV.jsx use identical shuffle algorithms (seededRandom, shuffleWithSeed, getDailySeed)
Synchronization works because both pages use the same daily seed (date-based) for consistent shuffle order
context_for_next_testing_agent: TV Guide now syncs with Live TV. The fix was adding 'random_play' to /api/tv-guide response. All 3 channels have random_play=true. At any given time, both pages show the same video playing for each channel. Schedule uses actual video durations (not hardcoded 30-min slots). Videos with 3:00 duration (like Video 1) are correctly shown as shorter than 5:00 duration videos.
